expires_today.title: The Best of C.J. Cherryh by Daw Books
expires_today.long_description: Traverse planets, galaxies, and whole universes of adventure and mystery in this bundle of award-winning author C.J. Cherryh’s best novels! expires_within_72h.description: Epic fantasies and far-flung space operas
expires_within_72h.long_description: Get a taste of some of the classics from renowned sci-fi and fantasy author Elizabeth Moon in this ebook mini-bundle! A peasant girl takes her fortune into her own hands and sets off to join an army in Sheepfarmer’s Daughter, the first in Moon’s epic fantasy saga The Deed of Paksenarrion! A former space armada officer captains a luxury yacht full of secrets in Heris Serrano, the first three books in The Serrano Legacy! Esmay Suiza continues the Serrano story in Once a Hero, and finds herself in the middle of a surprise conflict with the Bloodhorde! High adventures across medieval fantasy lands and the wilds of deep space await, so grab this mini-bundle of Elizabeth Moon ebooks for the price of your choosing, and support Canine Companions charity with your purchase!
